WITH per_rating AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS avg_per_day
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_per_day) AS across_rating_avg
  FROM per_rating
)
SELECT
  AVG(CASE WHEN p.avg_per_day > o.across_rating_avg THEN p.avg_per_day END) AS avg_per_day_above_average,
  AVG(CASE WHEN p.avg_per_day > o.across_rating_avg THEN p.avg_per_day - o.across_rating_avg END) AS avg_excess_over_average
FROM per_rating p
CROSS JOIN overall o;
